desc:
CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: A delectable combination of rich dark chocolate chunks, peanuts, raisins, and whole grain oats; A must-have for an on-the-go snack or in a lunch box

TRAIL MIX: Trail mix belongs in a snack bar; Enjoy a tasty combination of trail-ready whole nuts, chocolate, real fruit and delicious whole grain oats

ON-THE-GO ENERGY: Nature Valley Chewy Fruit and Nut Granola Bars provide the energy you need to help keep you going; A portable snack perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

TASTY SNACK: Made with real fruit and no artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 7.4 oz box of Nature Valley Dark Chocolate Nut Chewy Fruit and Nut Granola Bars; 6 bars
features:
Key Features:

Made with Whole Grain Oats

These bars are crafted using whole grain oats as the main ingredient, providing a wholesome, hearty base.

Chocolate Chunk Flavor

Loaded with rich chocolate chunks for a sweet, satisfying taste that appeals to both kids and adults.

No Artificial Additives

Free from artificial flavors, colors, and sweeteners, offering a cleaner, more natural snacking option.

Soft and Chewy Texture

Unlike crunchy granola bars, this variety is soft and chewy, making it easier and more enjoyable to eat.

Individually Wrapped

Each bar is individually packaged, making it convenient for lunch boxes, school snacks, road trips, or work breaks.

Benefits:

Convenient On-the-Go Snack

Perfect for busy lifestyles, these bars are easy to carry and require no preparation.

Satisfies Cravings

The combination of whole grains and chocolate chunks helps curb sweet cravings while still being relatively balanced.

Balanced Energy

Offers a moderate amount of carbs and fiber for sustained energy throughout the day.

Kid-Friendly and School-Safe

A popular choice for parents looking for a school-safe, nut-free snack (varies by flavor).

Portion-Controlled

Helps with mindful eating by providing a single-serving option without overindulging.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Corn Syrup, Semisweet Chocolate Chunks (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Roasted Peanuts, Raisins, Rice Flour, Sugar, Vegetable Glycerin, Canola Oil, Fructose, Corn Starch, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Barley Malt Extract, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
